title: Mowed
description: Cut five increasingly demanding yards into clean target stripes before fuel runs out, then earn and improve persistent grades.

prompt.objective: Build a lawn-mowing game where route planning, stripe patterns, fuel, and overlap determine the grade.

mintAssets.brief: A compact mower plus stylized trees, flowerbeds, fences, and a mischievous garden gnome.

experience: Drive and boost across five yards while a persistent lawn mask records every cut.
Grade coverage, stripe direction, fuel, and overlap, then persist best results and unlocks.
prompt.visualDirection: Bright miniature-garden dioramas, tactile grass stripes, friendly typography, and crisp arcade feedback.

thumbnail.alt: A small mower cutting alternating bright stripes across a stylized garden lawn.

social.title: Mowed
social.description: Cut clean lawn stripes, conserve fuel, and chase better grades across five yards.
